hooks.name: Patchwork reviews its own changes
hooks.description: When a source file is saved, ask the agent to run Patchwork's own idea against the edit: check the changed file's history and warn if the change undoes a decision recorded in a past commit. Dogfooding — the tool guards the tool.

action.prompt: A source file under src/ was just saved. Following the project steering (product.md, tech.md), reconstruct the knowledge behind this file from its git history (authors + the reasons recorded in notable commit messages). If the edit appears to undo or weaken a decision recorded in history (money-safety, security, rate limits, provider pricing, etc.), warn me with a one-line reason and the commit subject it is based on. If nothing is at risk, say so briefly. Do not fabricate — ground every point in the real history.
